summary: The narrator, feeling paranoid and unsafe after returning home, distrusts his laptop and room and suspects surveillance. He builds a homemade camera detector from a toilet-paper roll and ultra-bright LEDs wired in series to a nine-volt battery, and uses it to scan the room for hidden lenses. He finds no camera he can detect, though audio bugs or better cameras remain possible. He still feels strongly about the laptop he calls the Salmagundi and considers throwing it out.
one_line: A paranoid narrator builds a toilet-paper-tube camera detector from LEDs and scans his room for hidden spy cameras.
key_facts: The narrator builds a camera detector from a cardboard toilet-paper tube, ultra-bright white LEDs, wire, metal clips and a nine-volt battery.
The LEDs were scavenged from a dead bike-lamp and stored in a little plastic envelope in the narrator's parts box.
The narrator punched the LED leads through the cardboard tube using a pin to make the holes.
The LEDs are connected in series with small metal clips and the wires are twisted into the leads of a nine-volt battery.
The narrator built a similar device last year as a science fair project.
The narrator was thrown out of the science fair after showing hidden cameras in half the classrooms at Chavez High.
The narrator claims pinhead video cameras now cost less than a good restaurant dinner.
The detector works best in a dim room, where the viewer slowly scans walls and other hiding places for a reflection.
A reflection that stays still as the viewer moves is identified as a camera lens.
The narrator found no camera in his room that he could detect, though audio bugs or better cameras remained possible.
The narrator named his laptop the Salmagundi, which means anything made out of spare parts.
The narrator says that naming a laptop signals a deep relationship with it.
The narrator no longer wants to touch the laptop and considers throwing it out.
The narrator says he was feeling paranoid when he got home and felt like he was back in jail and the interrogation room.
